Who it’s for

Professional communication, not textbook drills.

Business English is most useful when it’s connected to the situations you actually face in an international workplace — your stand-up, your client call, your code review, your next interview.

  • You work with international teams or clients and want to speak more freely
  • You’re preparing to join an English-speaking company
  • You have job interviews in English coming up
  • You want a promotion that depends on how you present and persuade
  • You’re relocating and want to start with confidence

$45 / hour

Packages from 5 to 25 sessions for consistent practice. Packages stay valid for 3–6 months, depending on size.

See packages and approach

The path

From first session to job-ready English.

A structured path, reviewed every month and adjusted to what’s working. Nothing stays in the plan if it isn’t serving you.

  1. Orientation

    A placement assessment, your personal learning plan and a shared folder for vocabulary and resources.

  2. Core skills & habits

    A vocabulary system, speaking practice, writing reviewed live and a short daily practice routine.

  3. Career English

    Presentations from your real work, workplace role-plays, feedback, small talk and difficult conversations.

  4. Job readiness

    Your CV and LinkedIn in English, tech interview language, mock interviews and offer negotiation.

What a lesson looks like

One topic, real speaking, clear feedback.

Each session reviews vocabulary from last time, then moves into speaking practice and role-plays on one topic — tech news, business, a real work situation — while working through one item from your plan at a time.

  • Role-plays designed around moments you find uncomfortable at work
  • Corrections explained, not just given
  • New vocabulary heard in real speech, then practiced in context
  • A level retest every three months to measure progress

Questions

Business English FAQ.

What level do I need to start?

Intermediate (B1) or above. A short placement assessment at the start sets your level and shapes the plan.

Do you also cover grammar?

Yes, where it matters for your work — explained inside real examples, with short app-based practice between sessions for the basics.

Is the first session free?

Yes. The intro session is free and there’s no obligation.

Can my employer pay?

Yes. Receipts and invoices are available on request for employer reimbursement.
